description: Use this when the user wants to concentrate or get into work: a focus session before studying, a study break, deep work, before an exam, a short reset between tasks, or help to stop procrastinating and start. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation. Not for sleep audio (use find_sleep_sessions) or for breathing exercises (use find_breathing).

language.description: Audio language as a BCP-47 code (en, es, pt-BR, fr, it, ja, hi, ko, hu, or any other such as pl). Always pass the language the user writes in. If the language is not available the answer says so and gives the closest live one. hi, ko and hu are beta.

length_min.description: Length in minutes, 3 to 60. Default 10 when the user gives none.

name: find_focus
title: Find a focus session
